summary: Defined provider-neutral GoalContract, ClaimGraph, Claim, GateDefinition, and GatePlan contracts plus deterministic acceptance validation.
deterministic_validations: GoalContract criteria have unique stable IDs.
ClaimGraph claims have unique stable IDs.
Every Goal criterion is covered by at least one Claim.
Every Claim criterion reference points to the GoalContract.
Every required Claim has gateRefs or approvalRequired.
Every Claim gateRef and every GatePlan gateRef points to a registered GateDefinition.
GatePlan claimRefs point to existing Claims and match Claim gateRefs.
Claim dependencies point to existing Claims and are acyclic.
security and governance Claims cannot be optional or weakened by x-* extension override keys.
